thread:
carmen: heads-up — during yesterday's canary we saw user-facing latency spikes when the automatic fallback decision ran. root cause looked like the decision path waiting for a remote quota check.

mohit: ugh. saw that in the traces. decision spent ~120ms waiting for quota service + another 30ms for model-compat checks. totals add up.

ashley: can you paste the trace? is the request synchronous to quota or do we have an async path?

carmen: trace snippet:```
[2026-03-20T18:12:11.234Z] req=abcd fallback_decision start
[2026-03-20T18:12:11.354Z] req=abcd quota_check ok (120ms)
[2026-03-20T18:12:11.386Z] req=abcd model_compat ok (32ms)
[2026-03-20T18:12:11.387Z] req=abcd fallback_decision finish
```

tim: 150ms on the decision path is borderline for interactive flows. We should keep fallback decisions <20ms ideally.

luis: agreed. options: 1) local cached quota + eventual sync 2) short-circuit to a safe fallback if quota RPC exceeds threshold 3) move heavy checks off the hot path and rely on telemetry to retro-fit.

ashley: I like option 2 as a quick mitigation — we already have a concept of "decision_deadline_ms" in other places. If quota RPC > threshold, assume fallback-eligible and proceed.

mohit: sounds fine but risk is false positives (fallback when not needed). need to track those in telemetry so ops can tune.

ella-pm: from product POV, short-circuiting is acceptable for safety but we want clear metrics: #false-fallbacks, avg decision latency, and how many requests hit the short-circuit.

carmen: proposing a small config change in rollout policy:```yaml
fallback_policy:
  decision_deadline_ms: 25
  short_circuit_on_deadline: true
  log_short_circuit: true
  reason_tags: ["quota-slow", "compat-timeout"]
```
This keeps default behavior but forces a fast path.

tim: we also need to expose this in the console (per-rollout override + per-model default). ops should be able to see the short-circuit rate on the rollout dashboard.

luis: telemetry sketch: emit event `fallback_decision.outcome` with fields `[outcome:fallback|pass, path:normal|shortcircuit, latency_ms, reason]`. also emit sample request IDs to the playback queue when shortcircuit=true.

mohit: implementer note: keep sampling light — 1% or `min(1000/day, 0.01*requests)`. Otherwise storage explodes.

ashley: also add an invariant check in the API: if short_circuit_on_deadline=true, then decision_deadline_ms must be >= 10ms and <= 1000ms. prevents accidental zero.

ops-bot: deploy-plan created: rollback window 30m, feature-flag key rollout.fallback_shortcircuit, metric-alert fallback_shortcircuit_rate > 2% for 10m.

ella-pm: action items: 1) eng implement quick short-circuit + telemetry (mohit + luis) 2) console surface + per-rollout toggle (ashley) 3) docs + runbook note (carmen) — review by end of week?

carmen: yep. will open a small RFC + patch. I'll include the trace samples and worst-case numbers.

tim: one more UX ask: show a tiny badge on rollout list rows when short-circuit rate > 0.5% with hover text "fallback decisions hitting deadline". helps PMs spot noise.

mohit: ok starting a branch, will ping when tests pass.

ashley: thanks all. feel free to @channel if you need quick sign-off for the console changes. :raised_hands:

ops-bot: NOTE: monitoring alert template `fallback_shortcircuit_rate` created by ops-bot at 2026-03-21T09:10:00Z.

carmen: recorded. closing thread once RFC posted.
